messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content: I’m sorry, but Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any other Model) in India, so there is no official Indian price to quote. If you’re interested in the Model S price in the United States, it’s roughly $90,000 USD (plus taxes and fees). If you’d like to see what that would be in Indian rupees, let me know and I can fetch the current USD‑INR exchange rate for you.
